I think a lot of the folks in the "software is solved" camp aren't being bold enough.

item.title: Schevana v1 has been released. In Schevana V0, everything was drawn by Cairo. No
item.description:
Schevana v1 has been released.

In Schevana V0, everything was drawn by Cairo.
Now, in V1, everything is drawn via GPU...
Shaders are written in Scheme and compiled to GPU code.

There's a now a Boids 3D demo which can easily handle up to 5000 birds.
In that demo, everything runs on the GPU (calculations and graphics).

Boids 2D has also been updated to be far more efficient.
It can also handle up to 5000 birds.

I tested it on Ubuntu 26.04. Runs great there.

https://github.com/paveluv/Schevana/releases/tag/v1

item.description:

The video walks through a simple kinematics example.
